in_marathi.name: Anantdeep
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anantdeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anantdeep is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Anant' meaning endless and 'Deep' meaning deep or ocean. It represents the infinite and the depth of the universe. In Hindu mythology, Anant is also known as Vishnu's bed and the serpent king Shesha. The name signifies a deep connection with spirituality, wisdom, and inner peace.
